modules.name: stress_scenario_taxonomy_and_commitment_registry
modules.responsibility: Commit immutable scenarios before outcomes and calculate weighted material-risk coverage.

modules.name: historical_crisis_replay_and_regime_mapping_engine
modules.responsibility: Replay historical factor paths against frozen exposures while separating observed, translated and unavailable mappings.

modules.name: factor_shock_and_global_sensitivity_surface_engine
modules.responsibility: Evaluate multivariate response surfaces, interactions, extrapolation and constraint cliffs.

modules.name: conditional_extreme_value_tail_engine
modules.responsibility: Fit conditional POT/GPD tail models with diagnostics, threshold sensitivity and parameter uncertainty.

modules.name: distributional_ambiguity_and_worst_case_engine
modules.responsibility: Evaluate a finite-support Wasserstein-1 worst-case frontier for loss, CVaR and optional score.

modules.name: liquidity_capacity_crowding_and_fire_sale_engine
modules.responsibility: Compute nonlinear implementation cost, feasibility and capacity curves by AUM, with optional research-only network stress.

modules.name: reverse_stress_breakpoint_and_resilience_engine
modules.responsibility: Find the minimum weighted-L2 shock that breaches a committed failure condition and verify it by forward evaluation.

modules.name: stress_model_and_scenario_validation_gate
modules.responsibility: Validate scenario coverage, evidence quality, capacity monotonicity, reverse stress and specialist capability limitations.
